headline: Vineeth Sai Varikuntla breaks into ARC-3 gold

sections.text: Vineeth Sai Varikuntla gained 5.75 points to reach 40.09, climbing from 32nd to 9th on the public board.
The move puts Varikuntla inside the board’s 18 gold places, adding a new challenger to the medal group.
